title: Chess Opening Win-Rate Breakdown
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chess:game
| stats sum(eval(if(result="win",1,0))) as wins, count as games by opening
| where games>=5
| eval win_pct=round(100*wins/games,1)
| sort - win_pct
description: Breaks your chess results down by opening so you learn which lines actually win for you and which to drop.
value: Win-rate by opening is the fastest route to practical improvement, pointing your study where it pays off most.
implementation: Ingest game archives with opening tags; review win rate per opening with a minimum sample size.
visualization: Bar chart of win rate by chess opening.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which chess openings you win with most, so you know which to keep playing and which to drop.
